Definition: Tsidkijah, the name of six Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Zedekiah is the name of six men in Scripture, and the last king of Judah bears it. In 1 Kings 22:11, Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made him horns of iron. The fuller story is told on the Zedekiah, King of Judah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Zedekiah matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Jerusalem and the Exile
